**Top 3 (6–8 Nov), after dropping Lisbon and Seville for rain chances above 50%:**

| Rank | City | Avg high | Highs (Fri/Sat/Sun) | Rain chance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Valletta | 20.2°C | 21.1 / 19.7 / 19.7 | 41% / 42% / 31% |
| 2 | Palermo | 19.0°C | 19.0 / 18.0 / 17.9 | 42% / 37% / 38% |
| 3 | Valencia | 18.9°C | 19.1 / 19.2 / 18.4 | 14% / 12% / 20% |

- Valletta and Palermo are warmest, but both have drizzle or showers on all three days, with a thunderstorm forecast in Valletta on Friday.
- Valencia is only about 1°C cooler than Valletta and much drier, so it's the best pick if you want to stay dry.
- Just outside the top 3 are Barcelona (17.8°C), Naples (17.5°C) and Dubrovnik (16.4°C).
- Lisbon was dropped for 59% on Saturday and 56% on Sunday. Seville was dropped for 53% on Sunday.
